hero.subtitle: The interview log for people who want to remember.
hero.description: Open-source interview and hiring process tracker. Log every conversation, offer, and decision — from either side of the table.

pipeline.title: Pipeline
pipeline.description: Eight statuses, from first contact to signed offer. Every process shows where it stands — no digging through email.

numbers.title: Numbers, not vibes
numbers.description: Salary in figures with explicit currency. Stages counted. What they offered is what you compare.

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.description: Every call, take-home and offer, logged in Markdown. What they said in the second call is leverage in the fifth.

one.title: Your side of the table
one.description: Whoever keeps the record runs it. The model has no side — a candidate and a hiring team use the same one.

two.title: Memory is leverage
two.description: Remembering what they told you on the second call is negotiating power.

three.title: Numbers, not vibes
three.description: Salary in figures, currency explicit, stages counted. Data doesn't get dressed up.

four.title: Calm by default
four.description: No gamification, no confetti. A rejection is a status, not a failure. The interface never judges.

five.title: Yours to run
five.description: Open source, your data in your Postgres. Privacy is the premise.

yoursToRun.heading: Yours to run
yoursToRun.description: Self-hosted and open source. Your negotiations live in your Postgres, not on someone else's server.

finalCta.heading: Start the record.
finalCta.description: Add the first company you're talking to.

footer.tagline: tapuy — every question in the process, on record
